capabilities: Chat with locally installed Ollama models inside a chat view
Search the web via DuckDuckGo and answer with numbered citations
Save chat logs or the last answer as Markdown notes, including prompt-driven folder creation
Append AI-drafted summaries to the daily note
Pass context files from a designated folder to the model on every request
extras: A German README (README.de.md) documents German prompt phrases; pre-store beta versions are distributed via BRAT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with locally running AI models or feed web search results into answers without cloud services or API keys.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that embeds local AI models via Ollama directly into Obsidian.
Web search inside the chat – searches via DuckDuckGo, feeds the results back as context

summary: Chat client for local Ollama models with DuckDuckGo web search, persistent vault context, and saving chats or answers as notes.
